name: Munden Farm
tagline: Agriculture: A longtime farmer, a strawberry field and good neighbors
description: A working pumpkin patch in Anne Road, VA, Munden Farm grows Strawberries, Pumpkins, Corn, and Asparagus. The patch is busiest in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
